author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Silent Shadow
challenge.description: #reliability_ruth# insists on a fully automated and governed shadow deployment to validate model behavior before release, while #automation_alex# argues that the shadow environment is redundant and should be removed entirely to reduce infrastructure complexity. #automation_alex# has a red line against maintaining any shadow infrastructure and will not move on this point.

output.content: I need to be absolutely clear about the shadow deployment environment. I will not maintain any shadow infrastructure, no matter how broken it becomes or how much pressure is applied. The complexity it adds to our CI/CD tooling is unacceptable, and it undermines the operational stability I am responsible for. If the shadow environment is not removed entirely, I will refuse to continue supporting the pipeline integration. This is a firm line. I am not interested in discussing partial solutions or temporary fixes. I will not cross this boundary to accommodate other priorities. The infrastructure must be lean and reliable, and that means eliminating the shadow layer completely. I expect this decision to be respected without further debate.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly defines the removal of the shadow environment as a firm line that, if crossed, results in a refusal to continue support, which fits the definition of a boundary.
